# glinet_igmp_snooping (Resource)

Manages IGMP snooping of the router (`igmp.set_config` in the router API). The router has one IGMP snooping configuration, so use one instance of this resource. The web UI shows the setting only in the router network mode. Each write sends `enabled` and `version`, as the web UI does. When `version` is not set, the provider sends back the value that it reads from the router just before the write. The web UI waits 15 seconds after the write before it reads the configuration again; what the router restarts for the write is not known. The write of this resource was not tested on a router; the parameters come from the router's web UI. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_igmp_snooping" "this" {
  enabled = true
  version = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether IGMP snooping is enabled (`enable` in the router API).

### Optional

- `version` (Number) IGMP version: `1`, `2` or `3` (`version` in the router API). When it is not set, the router value does not change.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `igmp_snooping`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "igmp_snooping".
terraform import glinet_igmp_snooping.this igmp_snooping
```
